gloss: food and drink; food and beverage products

definitions.gloss: food and drink; food and beverage products
definitions.explanation: A collective term for items that are consumed as food or drink. Used in commercial, regulatory, and everyday contexts to refer to edible and drinkable goods.

examples.japanese: {飲食品|いんしょくひん}の{持|も}ち{込|こ}みは{禁止|きんし}です。
examples.english: Bringing in food and drink is prohibited.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}は{飲食品|いんしょくひん}を{中心|ちゅうしん}に{扱|あつか}っている。
examples.english: This store mainly deals in food and beverage products.

examples.japanese: {飲食品|いんしょくひん}の{価格|かかく}が{全体的|ぜんたいてき}に{上昇|じょうしょう}している。
examples.english: Prices of food and drink products are rising overall.

notes:
A compound of {飲食|いんしょく} (eating and drinking) and {品|ひん} (goods; products). Commonly seen on signs, in regulations, and in business contexts. The related term {飲食|いんしょく} refers to the act of eating and drinking, while {飲食品|いんしょくひん} specifically refers to the products themselves.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飲食品|いんしょくひん}の{持|も}ち{込|こ}み: bringing in food and drink
- {飲食品|いんしょくひん}の{販売|はんばい}: sale of food and beverages
- {飲食品|いんしょくひん}{売|う}り{場|ば}: food and beverage section

RELATED TERMS:
- {飲食|いんしょく}: eating and drinking — the activity rather than the products
- {飲食店|いんしょくてん}: restaurant; eatery — an establishment serving food and drink
- {食品|しょくひん}: food products — excludes beverages
- {飲料|いんりょう}: beverages; drinks — covers only the drink side
